important_limits: No actual timber/board/fastener product quality is verified by the reference property table.
No automatic fire action or fire load combination. Null demand gives REQUIRED_INPUT and no pass.
One-dimensional dchar0 is a reference equation only; section reduction uses notional dcharn. No claim that narrow45mm member satisfies the one-dimensional corner-geometry condition in3.4.2(3).
One-sided loss shifts centroid. Compression along the original axis may create eccentric bending and is not checked as concentric compression.
Protected/insulated assemblage fire response, separating function, stability and connection fire design excluded.
Racking conditional capacity is not full-wall approval. Missing actual nail/OSB design resistance or tie-down/detail flags blocks applicable capacity.
Racking source also requires studbuckling/bearing,sheetshearbuckling/centralfixing and inter-element transfer verification; these are not silently approved.
The handbook allows National Choice for MethodA and partialfactors. No current UKNA choice is asserted.

kdef returns the base table value only. The additional wet-installation/fibre-saturation provision in EN1995-1-1 3.2(4) is not applied automatically; installation moisture history remains a project input.
